Laurey Satin Nickel Modern Cabinet Pull

The Modern Satin Nickel Cabinet Pull has an interesting and sleek design great for adding a contemporary touch to any kitchen cabinet. This Satin Nickel Modern Cabinet Pull comes packaged with the mounting hardware. Its strong lines are made bolder by the Satin Nickel finish.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey Contempo Satin Nickel Cabinet Pull:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Satin Nickel
  • C/C Length: 3-3/4"
  • Overall Length: 4-3/4"
  • Width: 3/8"
  • Projection: 1-1/8"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.

This cabinet pull is part of the Laurey Contempo Collection.
